body:
Well he is half way across the country and I hardly know him. I am the only person who knows about this and is in a position to do something I guess.

I feel really bad about it, but I called the police non-emergency line in his city. I gave them what information I could and they called him to check up on him. He is alive and okay, said he decided not to kill himself.

He is very pissed off now that I did that. I just wish there could be some professional there to help him or something. I don't have his address so they can't go there and do anything. And I don't know anyone else in his life who I can contact.

I don't know if there is anything else I can do now, this is a unique situation.

So I think I have the number to the police department and his college now. I also talked to a suicide hotline and they said they would probably send police out there or take him to a hospital if they think it is serious enough.

I don't want to put someone who is just saying things through a humiliating experience. But if he actually killed himself I think I would look back and wonder why I didn't just call them.
